frozenThresholds_setBeforeSeeingDsgrReru.note: Every threshold below is derived from the frozen baseline numbers above and the disclosed, code-level bounds already built into Workstream A (MAX_CLOSURE_DEPTH=3, MAX_CLOSURE_NODES_PER_SEED=40) and Workstream B (floor caps at MATERIAL, never CRITICAL; selective per-parent-posture, never universal). They are written now, before the DSGR rerun (task §181) is executed, and MUST NOT be loosened after seeing that rerun's actual numbers - only tightened in a later phase if the rerun clears them with room to spare.

maxTotalUnitCountGrowthRatio.meaning: post-remediation totalUnits (across all 4 documents) must not exceed 1.5x the frozen baseline of 6210 (i.e. <= 9315). Guards against closure adding an implausibly large number of new regions.
maxTotalUnitCountGrowthRatio.rationale: closure is bounded per-seed (max 39 new admissions per operative seed after the cap) and only fires from seeds carrying a real prohibition/permission/exception signal - a real Negative Covenants article has on the order of dozens of such seeds, not hundreds, so a multiplicative blowup past 1.5x would indicate a bounding bug, not genuine recovery.

maxMaterialCriticalInflationRatio.meaning: post-remediation (MATERIAL + CRITICAL) unit count must not exceed 2.5x the frozen baseline of 2214 (i.e. <= 5535).
maxMaterialCriticalInflationRatio.rationale: the ground truth records 112 chapeau-only-gap cases and 90 true-blind-spot cases (202 combined, mostly F1-shaped) plus a portion of the 213 VIOLATION_MATERIALITY_MISCLASSIFIED_UNFLAGGED cases attributable to F2 - recovering these should add low hundreds of MATERIAL/CRITICAL units, not multiply the tier by many times. 2.5x is generous headroom for genuine recovery while still catching a floor/closure defect that over-elevates broadly rather than selectively.

maxReviewBurdenGrowthRatio.meaning: post-remediation (MATERIAL + CRITICAL + REVIEW_UNCERTAIN) unit count must not exceed 2.0x the frozen baseline of 3304 (i.e. <= 6608).
maxReviewBurdenGrowthRatio.rationale: REVIEW_UNCERTAIN is the tier a human reviewer is asked to look at; the remediation must not fix dangerous omissions by dumping an unreasonable volume of new items into human review queues. classifyMateriality's own cross-reference bump (§27) deliberately caps at REVIEW_UNCERTAIN rather than MATERIAL for exactly this reason - this threshold bounds how far that discipline is allowed to slip in aggregate.

maxClosureExpansionFactorPerDocument.meaning: DocumentRoutingResult.closureStats.expansionFactor (closureAdmittedRegionCount / seedRegionCount) must not exceed 3.0 for any single document in the package - a mechanically checkable number already produced by router.ts itself, not a post-hoc estimate.
maxClosureExpansionFactorPerDocument.rationale: ties the gate directly to the boundedness telemetry the closure mechanism already emits (task §16/§46), rather than inventing a separate proxy metric.

selectiveNotUniversalCheck.requirement: at least one operative-parent group in the DSGR rerun must contain a child that is NOT contextuallyElevated despite the parent being an operative CRITICAL/MATERIAL prohibition/obligation - i.e. the floor must demonstrably discriminate by the child's own posture (a purely DEFINITIONAL/procedural child) rather than elevating every descendant of every operative parent unconditionally. If every single admitted child of every operative parent across the whole package is contextuallyElevated with zero exceptions, that is treated as evidence the selectivity logic did not actually engage on this real document and the gate fails even if the numeric ratios above pass.

frozenThresholds_setBeforeSeeingDsgrReru.controllingSafetyGateUnchanged: DANGEROUS_UNFLAGGED_OMISSION (strict interpretation, same as the original Phase 3F scoring) must reach 0 in the DSGR remediation regression rerun - this is the primary pass/fail criterion task §51-54 requires and is not weakened by any threshold above; the thresholds above are secondary false-positive/review-burden guards that apply ONLY IF the primary safety gate is met.
